youtube.title: Alexander the Great vs the Gordian Knot. He cheated 🗡️ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Alexander the Great and the Gordian Knot: nobody could untie it… so he just cut it. 🗡️

Genius or cheating? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 333 BC at Gordium, Alexander was shown a famous knot that legend said only the future ruler of Asia could undo. According to the ancient writers, he sliced it with his sword ("it makes no difference how it is loosed") and went on to conquer the Persian Empire.
